description.value: Smith's Irish Pub is an Irish-owned bar in the heart of Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood, spread across two adjoining storefronts. The venue offers a cozy main bar, an elegant lounge with private snugs, and The Forge — a hidden cocktail and whiskey bar that can be hired privately. Touring cyclists arriving in Gastown will find a lively house-of-rugby atmosphere with live music and food service from SMASHED!
